verified_behaviors: Export desk opens a snapshot letter with a real share URL and the original title, score and appearance.
A new hash arrival and real reload only preview; the existing dawn song and moon appearance remain before acceptance.
Acceptance with appearance unchecked restores the received song while retaining the reader's sky.
One music undo returns the previous dawn song and redo restores the received song; reload remembers it without reopening the letter.
Acceptance with appearance checked adopts the sender's sky; corrupt pasted and hash letters never replace the workspace.
Editing pasted content immediately disables acceptance until it is parsed again.
The original collection still has one entry and opening the manuscript after receipt begins from an original-track copy.
At 390px the copy, unfold and accept actions are reachable and complete through actual clicks.
A fresh receiver page has zero captured error logs and accepts a plain SL1 code; fresh accept and reload leave its dialog closed.
limitations: Physical phone, full screen reader and denied-clipboard branches were not independently retested in this release.
In-app evaluate only exposes read-only DOM; application state was checked by visible controls, the letter payload and actual downloads rather than private globals.
Tabbit could not create a page; its two reusable v1.8 scripts were not executed successfully this release.
Some screenshot requests captured the preceding frame; screenshots were inspected and named for their actual contents, and a natural-window letter was captured again.
Musical and visual preference remain for the user's local trial.
